title: States/UTs Food Secretaries Conference reviews various issues pertaining to Department of Food and Public Distribution
date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                01 SEP 2026 8:39PM by PIB Delhi
upsc_summary: PDS Specification Change: Under PMGKAY, raw rice procured will allow up to 10% broken grains (down from 25%) and parboiled rice 5% (down from 16%) to improve rice quality.
New Storage Policy: Targets creation of 131 LMT additional foodgrain storage capacity (111 LMT by States and 20 LMT by FCI) to address procurement-offtake mismatches.

Technology in PDS: Introduction of AI-based image validation on Procurement Centre Smart-Assessment Portal (PCSAP) and mandatory Vehicle Location Tracking System (VLTS) for GPS tracking of PDS vehicles.

Digital Initiatives & Reforms: Extension of Digital Rupee-based DBT pilot for Fair Price Shop (FPS) dealer margins, rollout of SARTHAK-PDS (2026–31), and integration of AgriStack in paddy procurement.
e-KYC & TPDS Rules: New SOPs under amended TPDS (Control) Order 2015 for silent and duplicate ration cards featuring temporary disablement and a 3-month revalidation window.

date:
प्रविष्टि तिथि:

upsc_summary: Defence Production Data: Total domestic defence production reached a record ₹1.8 lakh crore in FY 2025–26, with 16 Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs) contributing ₹1.29 lakh crore.
DPSU Financial Performance: Seven major DPSUs paid a combined dividend of ₹3,951 crore to the Central Government for FY 2025–26.
Indigenisation & Modernisation Roadmaps: Government released strategic publications including 'Aatmanirbhar DPSU' and HAL's 5-year Indigenisation and Modernisation Roadmaps to drive self-reliance.
